description: This file contains C++ source code implementing JNI bindings and utility functions for PyTorch on Android, including tensor creation, conversion, and JNI registration.

classes.name: JHashMap
classes.description: A JNI wrapper for Java HashMap, providing create and put methods.

classes.name: TensorHybrid
classes.description: A JNI hybrid class representing a PyTorch tensor, with methods for conversion between C++ and Java representations.

classes.name: PyTorchAndroidJni
classes.description: JNI interface for Android-specific PyTorch functions, such as setting thread count.

methods.name: deviceJniCodeToDeviceType
methods.description: Converts JNI device code to PyTorch device type.

methods.name: newAtTensor
methods.description: Creates a new PyTorch tensor from a Java buffer, shape, dtype, and memory format.

methods.name: TensorHybrid::initHybrid
methods.description: Initializes a TensorHybrid object from a Java Tensor object.

methods.name: TensorHybrid::newJTensorFromAtTensor
methods.description: Creates a Java Tensor object from a C++ at::Tensor.

methods.name: TensorHybrid::newAtTensorFromJTensor
methods.description: Creates a C++ at::Tensor from a Java Tensor object.

methods.name: JIValue::newJIValueFromStringDict
methods.description: Creates a JIValue representing a dictionary with string keys from a C++ dict.

methods.name: JIValue::newJIValueFromIntDict
methods.description: Creates a JIValue representing a dictionary with long keys from a C++ dict.

methods.name: JIValue::newJIValueFromAtIValue
methods.description: Converts a C++ at::IValue to a JIValue for JNI communication.

methods.name: JIValue::JIValueToAtIValue
methods.description: Converts a JIValue back to a C++ at::IValue.
